approvers: Tax adviser, bank, notary, my family
reason: A Belize shell with no track record and no money committed is not who I hand my life's work to. My tax adviser and notary would laugh me out of the room, and I would worry what happens to my nine people.
objection: Belize, no track record, no committed funding. If the money never comes, I have lost years and my staff have lost their trust in me. And 30% over three years from a company like that is a promise on paper.
instead: Keep running the shop myself, and when I am ready look for a buyer through my tax adviser, the chamber of commerce or nexxt-change, someone I can meet who has a German bank behind them.
would_change_my_mind: A German or EU buyer with proof of funds already at a bank, references from earlier acquisitions, and the 30% deferred part secured by a bank guarantee, with my adviser vouching for them.
